svg.aria-label: CD player, every control at 0, then at 100

An isometric CD deck with a shiny disc and a smeared bow of light, and beside it a pair of headphones standing in the same projection, the wave they play running between their pads, joined to the deck by a cord that drops off the bottom of the screen, every control at 0
